title: Protein-DNA co-condensation is prewetting to a collapsed polymer.
authors: Rouches, Mason N; Machta, Benjamin B
one_liner_zh: 该文用格子蒙特卡洛模拟和平均场理论研究蛋白质-DNA共凝聚导致的聚合物塌缩预润湿相变，虽非直接TF-DNA结合位点预测，但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作与相分离机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA动态结合建模。
abstract: The three-dimensional organization of chromatin is thought to play an important role in controlling gene expression. Specificity in expression is achieved through the interaction of transcription factors and other nuclear proteins with particular sequences of DNA. At unphysiological concentrations, many of these nuclear proteins can phase separate in the absence of DNA. In vivo, the thermodynamic forces driving these phases lead the chromosome to co-condense with nuclear proteins. However, it is unclear how DNA, itself a long polymer subject to configurational transitions, interacts with three-dimensional protein phases. Here, we show that a long compressible polymer can be coupled to interacting protein mixtures, leading to a generalized prewetting transition where polymer collapse is coincident with a locally stabilized liquid droplet. We use lattice Monte-Carlo simulations and a mean-field theory to show that these phases can be stable even in regimes where both polymer collapse and coexisting liquid phases are unstable in isolation and that these new transitions can be either abrupt or continuous. For polymers with internal linear structure, we further show that changes in the concentration of bulk components can lead to changes in three-dimensional polymer structure. In the nucleus, there are many distinct proteins that interact with many different regions of chromatin, potentially giving rise to many different prewet phases. The simple systems we consider here highlight chromatin's role as a lower-dimensional surface whose interactions with proteins are required for these novel phases.
abstract_zh: 染色质的三维组织被认为在控制基因表达中扮演重要角色。表达的特异性通过转录因子及其他核蛋白与特定DNA序列的相互作用实现。在非生理浓度下，许多这类核蛋白在无DNA存在时也能发生相分离 (phase separation)。在体内，驱动这些相的热力学力量导致染色体与核蛋白共凝聚。然而，尚不清楚DNA——本身作为经历构象转变的长聚合物——如何与三维蛋白质相相互作用。在此，我们展示了一种长可压缩聚合物能与相互作用的蛋白质混合物耦合，导致一种广义预润湿转变，其中聚合物塌缩与局部稳定的液滴同时发生。我们使用格子蒙特卡洛模拟 (lattice Monte-Carlo simulations) 和平均场理论 (mean-field theory) 表明，即使在聚合物塌缩和共存液相单独存在时均不稳定的条件下，这些相也能保持稳定，并且这些新转变可以是突变的或连续的。对于具有内部线性结构的聚合物，我们进一步表明，体相组分浓度的变化可导致三维聚合物结构的改变。在细胞核中，存在许多不同的蛋白质，它们与染色质的多个不同区域相互作用，可能产生多种不同的预湿相。我们在此考虑的简单系统突显了染色质作为低维表面的角色，其与蛋白质的相互作用是这些新相形成的必要条件。
